solutions.check: grid and clues read from the FT's printable PDF, its numbering matching the clue list; every fifteensquared answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: The box Pandora's opening a year late unfortunately holds the ultimate in sin

indicators.note: Pandora's opening is the first letter of that name
holds means the jumbled letters keep another letter within them
unfortunately suggests things gone wrong, so the words a year late are jumbled
the ultimate in sin is that word's final letter

explanation.surface: Pandora opens her famous box a year behind schedule, and of course out comes sin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unfortunately' rearranges A YEAR LATE into EALTYAREA, which 'holds' the N from 'the ultimate in sin', all after the P from 'Pandora's opening'.
explanation.definitionFit: In football the penalty area is commonly called the box, the marked rectangle in front of goal.

clue.text: Fight to keep control, initially, after turning up for social event

indicators.note: after places the fight with its insert behind the turned word
turning means the little word up is read the other way round
to keep means the fight word holds another letter inside it

parts.note: a brawl is a fight

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of the word control

explanation.surface: Someone keeps a scrap under control and shows up for a party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' looks like part of the phrase 'turning up', meaning arriving, but 'turning' is the reversal signal and 'up' its fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: A pub crawl is a sociable evening of drinking at a series of bars, so a social outing.

clue.text: Hooker taking figure across single bed

indicators.note: across means the figure word spans either side of the other pieces

parts.note: nine is a figure, a number
I, the Roman numeral one, stands for single
a cot is a small bed

explanation.surface: A prostitute takes a large sum spread over a single bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hooker' tempts as a prostitute, but it means something that hooks you, an addictive substance.
explanation.definitionFit: A hooker in this playful sense is something addictive, and the drug in tobacco is notoriously habit-forming.

clue.text: Prick boil, and look to slice top off

indicators.note: to slice top off means the first letter of the look word is removed

parts.note: a glance is a look

explanation.surface: Instructions for treating a boil: pierce it, and check before cutting.
explanation.definitionFit: To lance a boil is to pierce it with a blade so it drains, the classic medical phrase.

clue.text: Sailor, hearty at sea, rounding cape

indicators.note: rounding means the mixed letters go around the cape abbreviation
at sea means confused, so the letters of hearty are mixed up

parts.note: C is the map abbreviation for cape

explanation.surface: A jolly sailor on the ocean sails round a headland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at sea' mixes HEARTY into YAHTER, which goes 'rounding' C.
explanation.definitionFit: A yachter is a person who sails a yacht, so a kind of sailor.

clue.text: Assembly's three minutes of fighting completed?

parts.note: a boxing round lasts three minutes
up means finished, as in time is up

explanation.surface: A boxing bout's opening three minutes wraps up a gathering.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's is 'is', a link word joining definition and wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A roundup is a gathering together, as of cattle or of suspects, so an assembly.

clue.text: Tiger's rare bird, a burden

definitions.meaning: in golf, the rare score three under par, as Tiger Woods might make
a heavy weight one carries, from the bird hung round the Ancient Mariner's neck

explanation.walkthrough: Tiger is the golfer Tiger Woods; golf scores are named after birds, the rarest being three under par.
explanation.definitionFit: Golf names a score three under par after the seabird, and the Coleridge poem made it an image of guilt one carries.

clue.text: Line delivered in sarcasm

indicators.note: delivered in means the letters sit within the word sarcasm

explanation.surface: A remark spoken with heavy irony.
explanation.definitionFit: An arc is a curved line, part of a circle's circumference.

clue.text: Attack predecessors of PM and Obama

parts.note: AM, morning, comes before PM, afternoon
George W Bush was the president before Obama; predecessors covers him too

explanation.surface: A call to strike at the earlier holders of the British premiership and the American presidency.
explanation.walkthrough: 'predecessors of' serves both nouns at once: the morning hours come before the afternoon, and a president came before Obama.
explanation.definitionFit: An ambush is a surprise attack from a hidden position.

clue.text: Sharp corner, for starters, atop bar

indicators.note: atop in a down clue puts the first piece above the second
for starters takes the opening letter of the word corner

parts.note: a lever is a bar used to prise or lift

explanation.surface: A sharp corner sits on top of a bar, perhaps a hazard in a pub.
explanation.definitionFit: Sharp in the sense of quick-witted or intelligent, as in a sharp mind.

clue.text: Airline fraud, pig

parts.note: BA is British Airways
a con is a fraud or swindle

explanation.surface: A list of complaints: an airline, a swindle, a greedy person.
explanation.definitionFit: Bacon is cured meat from a pig, and figuratively a pig's carcass as a meat.

clue.text: Tragically, Greenland's seals are so friendly

definitions.meaning: seals hunted by clubbing could be called able to be clubbed
sociable, fit to belong to a club

explanation.walkthrough: The answer read whimsically is 'able to be clubbed', the grim fate of seals in the hunt, while its real meaning is sociable.
explanation.definitionFit: A clubbable person is sociable and good company, the sort welcome in a gentlemen's club.

clue.text: Left gift in grass

indicators.note: in places the gift word inside the grass word

parts.note: a reed is a tall grass
a treat is a gift or indulgence

explanation.surface: A present was left lying in the long grass.
explanation.definitionFit: Retreated means withdrew or went away, so left in the sense of departed.

clue.text: Dash, or style

definitions.meaning: a small amount, as a dash of salt
discernment in what looks good, as in good dress sense

explanation.definitionFit: A taste is a small sample, a dash; and taste is aesthetic judgement, style.

clue.text: House turns gold

parts.note: winds means turns, as a road winds
or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: A building's colour changes to gold.
explanation.walkthrough: House here is a royal dynasty, not a building.
explanation.definitionFit: Windsor is the name of the British royal house since 1917.

clue.text: Pile where rubbish approaches, nothing missing

indicators.note: rubbish, as a verb, means to trash, so the letters are shuffled

parts.note: taken as written, the anagram fodder
O looks like zero, nothing; missing says it is taken away

explanation.surface: A heap of junk grows nearer, with nothing left out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'missing' removes the O ('nothing') from APPROACHES, and 'rubbish' rearranges what remains.
explanation.definitionFit: A scrapheap is a pile of discarded material or junk.

clue.text: In which to see water polo, perhaps

definitions.text: In which to see water polo, perhaps

indicators.note: water as a verb means to dilute, so the letters of polo are mixed

explanation.surface: Where you would watch water polo.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' marks the whole clue as an example: the anagram also defines.
explanation.definitionFit: A swimming pool is the body of water where water polo is played.

clue.text: Certain players' club

parts.note: the cast is the set of actors in a play
an iron is a type of golf club

explanation.surface: A theatre company's sure-fire social group.
explanation.definitionFit: Cast-iron as an adjective means unbreakable or guaranteed, as in a cast-iron alibi.

clue.text: Covering metres, tailor reaches for fine cloth

indicators.note: covering means the rearranged letters enclose the metres abbreviation
tailor means alter and shape, so the letters of reaches are rearranged

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for metres

explanation.surface: A tailor measures out metres of fine fabric.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tailor' turns REACHES into CASHERE, which is 'Covering' M.
explanation.definitionFit: Cashmere is fine soft wool from Kashmir goats, a luxury fabric.

clue.text: Reduce yield

explanation.definitionFit: To crop is to trim or reduce, and a crop is a harvest or yield.

clue.text: One throwing a large vessel

definitions.meaning: the player who throws the ball in baseball
a jug, a container for liquid

explanation.definitionFit: A baseball pitcher throws the ball, and a pitcher is also a large jug.

clue.text: Devil missing lead in Hollywood opera house

indicators.note: in places the trimmed devil word within the city abbreviation

parts.note: LA, Los Angeles, is home to Hollywood

indicators.note: missing lead means the first letter of the devil word goes

parts.note: a rascal is a little devil

explanation.surface: A demon with no starring role turns up in a Hollywood opera house.
explanation.definitionFit: La Scala in Milan is one of the world's most famous opera houses.

clue.text: Sign's welcoming in lush hot country

indicators.note: welcoming in means the sign word takes the next pieces inside it

parts.note: Leo is a sign of the zodiac; the 's is is, a link
a sot is a drunkard, a lush
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: A notice of welcome in a lush, hot land.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lush' looks like a lush green landscape, but it is a noun for a drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: Lesotho is a landlocked kingdom in southern Africa, an independent country.

clue.text: Tenor introducing himself, briefly, as foolish high-flier

parts.note: a speaker introducing himself says I

indicators.note: briefly means the tenor's name loses its last letter

parts.note: Enrico Caruso was the famous Italian tenor

explanation.surface: An opera singer announces himself as the reckless one who flew too high.
explanation.walkthrough: The tenor says 'I, Caruso', cut short; Icarus flew too near the sun on wax wings.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Icarus flew too close to the sun, so his wings melted: the type of foolish ambition.

clue.text: Rabbit on crisp golden pancake

definitions.meaning: British slang for chatter on at length
a batter cake cooked in a grid-patterned iron

explanation.definitionFit: To waffle is to talk aimlessly at length, and a waffle is a crisp grid-patterned batter cake.

clue.text: Bite the winner

definitions.meaning: to chew noisily, as a horse does its bit

explanation.definitionFit: To champ is to chew or bite noisily, and champ is short for champion, a winner.

clue.text: Confirm one's ability to light up game

parts.note: to test is to check what someone can do
a match is what you strike to light up a cigarette

explanation.surface: A player proves they can fire up a game.
explanation.walkthrough: A test match is an international cricket game.
explanation.definitionFit: A test match is an international match, especially in cricket or rugby, so a game.

clue.text: Yours truly leading people after uprising, as Argentinian politician

indicators.note: leading puts the first piece at the top of this down entry

parts.note: yours truly is a jokey way to say me

indicators.note: after uprising means the people word reads upwards, backwards in a down clue

parts.note: men means people

explanation.surface: Me heading a popular revolt, like a South American leader.
explanation.definitionFit: Carlos Menem was President of Argentina from 1989 to 1999.

clue.text: Bullet sent from holster, if misfiring

indicators.note: misfiring means going wrong, so the letters of holster and if are scrambled

explanation.surface: A round fired from a gun still in its holster after a malfunction.
explanation.definitionFit: A rifle shot is a single discharge from a rifle, effectively a fired bullet.

clue.text: Bottle still to be knocked back, containing last of liquor

indicators.note: containing means the turned word holds the final letter
knocked back means turned backwards, like a drink downed

parts.note: even means still, as in even now

indicators.note: last of takes the final letter of the word liquor

explanation.surface: A bottle yet to be downed, holding the last of the spirits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be knocked back' turns EVEN into NEVE, which is 'containing' R.
explanation.definitionFit: Bottle is British slang for courage, the same as nerve.

clue.text: Understand letter when read aloud

indicators.note: when read aloud means the letter is said, not written

parts.note: the letter in question is C, as the sound gives away

explanation.surface: Grasping what a letter says when it is spoken.
explanation.definitionFit: To see is to grasp or comprehend, as in I see what you mean.

clue.text: Show building or farm in the money

indicators.note: in puts the rebuilt letters inside the money word

parts.note: pence is money, British coins

indicators.note: building means constructing, so the letters or farm are reassembled

explanation.surface: A production sited in a building or on a farm with a fat budget.
explanation.walkthrough: 'building' rebuilds OR FARM into RFORMA, sitting 'in' PENCE.
explanation.definitionFit: A performance is a show, an entertainment presented to an audience.
